title: Tiny, cute umbrella
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g transform='translate(50, 48)'>
    <!-- handle shaft -->
    <rect x='-2' y='8' width='4' height='30' rx='2' fill='#c89b6a'/>
    <!-- handle curve (hook) -->
    <path d='M0 38 C0 46, -8 46, -8 40' stroke='#c89b6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- handle end glow -->
    <circle cx='-8' cy='40' r='3' fill='#e8b87a'/>
    <!-- canopy -->
    <path d='M-38 8 C-38 -18, -18 -34, 0 -34 C18 -34, 38 -18, 38 8 C28 2, 18 -2, 0 -2 C-18 -2, -28 2, -38 8 Z' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
    <!-- canopy top highlight -->
    <path d='M-30 2 C-30 -14, -14 -28, 0 -28 C14 -28, 30 -14, 30 2' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fa8' stroke-width='0'/>
    <!-- canopy scallops -->
    <path d='M-38 8 C-28 2, -18 -2, 0 -2 C18 -2, 28 2, 38 8' fill='none' stroke='#d43a5c' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- canopy segments -->
    <line x1='0' y1='-34' x2='0' y2='-2' stroke='#d43a5c' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='-20' y1='-28' x2='-22' y2='1' stroke='#d43a5c' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='20' y1='-28' x2='22' y2='1' stroke='#d43a5c' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- top knob -->
    <circle cx='0' cy='-36' r='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='-36' r='2' fill='#fff3b0'/>
    <!-- cute face on canopy -->
    <circle cx='-10' cy='-14' r='2.5' fill='#fff'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='-14' r='2.5' fill='#fff'/>
    <circle cx='-10' cy='-13' r='1.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='-13' r='1.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
    <path d='M-5 -7 Q0 -3 5 -7' stroke='#fff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- blush -->
    <circle cx='-20' cy='-8' r='3' fill='#ff9bb0' opacity='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='20' cy='-8' r='3' fill='#ff9bb0' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
